-- 張溰榆 的繳費記錄
INSERT INTO paymentRecords (studentId, paymentPeriod, amount, paymentDate, status, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT id, 'Q1', 1440.0, '2026-01-15', 'confirmed', NOW(), NOW()
FROM students 
WHERE name = '張溰榆' 
  AND venue = '蒲崗村道場'
  AND scheduleDay LIKE '%星期五%'
LIMIT 1;
